title: Neural-comet metabolism replicates on fresh seeds 5 and 6: comets form from noise, swim up to 27-42 body lengths and multiply (gen 2-3); cutting resource recovery at t=500 leaves 0 comets by t~620 on both seeds; a left-half cut empties the left half, while the uncut half keeps 11-12 against 22 fed
summary: Ran world.py unchanged on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (128^2, t=1000, spf 50): fed: 37 and 40 final comets, 10 and 11 persistent splits, generation 2 and 3, max 27.4 and 42.1 body lengths, from correlated noise over the whole domain (fed/seed5/sheet.png t=0). Fork at t=500 with recovery of the synaptic resource stopped everywhere (cut_t 500): 0 comets at the end on both seeds; on seed 5 both halves are empty by t~620 (fc_s5.png). Left-half cut (cut_half 1, seed 5): the left half goes 15 -> 0 by t~700, while the uncut right half falls from 23 to 11-12 against 22 in the fed twin.

observations.S: fed/seed5/sheet.png t=0: correlated noise over the whole domain; comets everywhere by t=40
observations.I: fed/seed5/sheet.png: discrete comets tracked through t=1000
observations.M: fed/seed5, seed6 FACTS: max 27.4 and 42.1 body lengths
observations.E: fc_s5.png / forkcount_s5.txt: recovery cut everywhere -> 0 comets by t~620 (fed 37-40); left-half cut -> 0 in the left half, 11-12 in the right vs 22 fed

seeds_run.result: pass: fed 10 persistent splits, gen 2; global cut 0 comets; half cut kills the cut half
pass: fed 11 persistent splits, gen 3; global cut 0 comets

controls_run.E: fork_all/seed5-6 and fork_left (seed 5) against fed/seed5-6, identical until t=500

by_construction: E (coupling is scaled by a resource that firing depletes and that recovers on time tr)
verdicts.limitation: The half cut is not cleanly local: the uncut half loses about half its comets (11-12 vs 22 fed), most likely because self-propelled comets cross into the cut half and die there. Generation reached 2 on seed 5 (comets from noise, so 2 is enough). I ran spf 50 as the claim's packs; no dt/2.
